cover.headline: New York City Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade Postponed Due to High Winds
paragraphs: New York City’s annual Macy’s Thanksgiving Day parade has been __**postponed**__ due to excessively windy weather and will now be held on Saturday instead of Thursday. Forecasters say an impending storm on Thursday may spoil the street party, which is traditionally marked by a march of huge inflatable balloons among the city skyscrapers and historic downtown areas.

AccuWeather is forecasting sustained winds of 12 to 25 mph and rain later on Thursday. Under safety guidelines, large balloons must stay grounded if sustained winds exceed 23 mph or gusts exceed 34 mph. The parade balloons have been __**suspended**__ only once previously because of weather, back in 1971, creating a rare historical precedent for the organizers.

NBC quoted Macy’s executives as saying that the safety of participants and spectators is the top priority for everyone involved. The giant balloons will be deflated on Wednesday night and stored securely in neighbouring New Jersey until they are reinflated for the rescheduled Saturday celebration, ensuring that no potential accidents occur during the severe weather event.

This year the parade will include a vibrant tribute to Dolly Parton led by Megan Hilty, along with special appearances by Melissa Joan Hart and other stars leading the way for Santa Claus. Nine Broadway shows will be featured as part of a ten-minute medley instead of full show numbers, providing a delightful musical experience for the millions of viewers tuning in from home.

The Macy’s parade began in 1924 to create buzz for the department store holiday windows at Herald Square. Organizers borrowed animals from the Central Park Zoo for the early parades but ended the practice in 1927 after children became frightened by the live creatures, leading to the introduction of the famous inflatable novelties that we see today.

The parades were fully cancelled previously only in 1942, 1943, and 1944 because valuable materials needed for the balloons were diverted for the World War Two effort. The modern holiday tradition returns this weekend after meticulous planning, and local authorities are working to ensure a smooth rescheduling process for all attendees and international visitors.

Local businesses and tourism boards anticipate that shifting the event to Saturday will still generate significant economic activity for the city. Hotels, restaurants, and retail stores near the parade route have adjusted their staffing schedules to accommodate the massive crowds expected over the weekend, turning a potential weather disruption into a __**proactive__** opportunity for local commerce.

world.headline: Ukraine Strikes Russian Airbase
paragraphs: The Ukrainian General Staff says its forces struck a major military base in the Nizhny Novgorod region east of Moscow. Ukrainian forces successfully hit the Savasleyka airbase, damaging five aircraft used to launch missiles and bombs.

The General Staff stated that three MiG-31 jets and two Su-34 fighter-bombers were impacted in the latest long-range attack. Russia did not immediately comment on the report provided by the military command.

The operation follows recent strikes in Libyan waters and the Gulf of Finland, as well as damage to the Crimea bridge. Fighting has continued since the full-scale invasion in February 2022, causing ongoing regional instability.

world.headline: Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt Settle Legal Battle
paragraphs: Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie have settled a long-running legal battle over her sale of a stake in their French vineyard. The dispute unfolded amid their bitter divorce proceedings over the past several years.

Representatives for both Hollywood stars released a joint statement confirming they settled out of court in the best interests of their family. They bought a controlling interest in Château Miraval in 2008 and shared years of business ventures together.

Pitt had argued that Jolie acted without permission in selling her share to a Russian oligarch. Jolie counter-sued with allegations regarding a 2016 private flight, but both sides have now resolved their respective legal actions amicably.

thailand.headline: Phuket to Host Major Muay Thai Stadium
paragraphs: Rajadamnern Muay Thai Stadium plans to open its first venue outside Bangkok at Central Phuket in early 2029. The project represents an investment of more than one billion baht as operators aim to attract one million tourists annually.

The complex will cover nine thousand square metres and accommodate about two thousand five hundred spectators. It will feature live bouts, cultural shows, and a museum alongside dining and retail outlets.

Global Sport Ventures and Central Pattana are collaborating on the expansion to promote the traditional sport. Architecture firms Populous and Nikken Sekkei are involved in designing the new combat sports venue.

thailand.headline: Thai Politician Authorises Legal Action Over Allegations
paragraphs: Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap has authorised legal action against People's Party MP Rukchanok Srinork over allegations portraying her and her husband as scammers. The political dispute has drawn widespread public attention across various media platforms in recent days.

The conflict began in October when opposition politicians questioned the government about online gambling networks and asset declarations. Suchada firmly denied the accusations during a press conference and stated she would prove the facts in court.

Rukchanok expressed readiness to face legal action while insisting she never called the husband a scammer directly. The ongoing political clash continues to develop as both parties present their arguments to the public and legal advisors.

feature.headline: Creating an Eco-Friendly Home Environment for Daily Well-Being
paragraphs: Modern urban living often disconnects us from natural rhythms, making home environmental design more important than ever. Transforming our living spaces into sustainable sanctuaries requires intentional choices rather than drastic lifestyle overhauls. By focusing on small daily habits, residents can __**substantially__** reduce their ecological footprint while improving indoor air quality and mental clarity in their living spaces.

A __**pivotal__** step involves optimizing natural light and ventilation throughout the apartment or house. Heavy drapes can be replaced with sheer fabrics that invite daylight in, reducing the need for artificial daytime lighting. Indoor plants also serve as natural air purifiers, adding vitality to living areas while helping to regulate indoor humidity levels naturally. Selecting durable, locally sourced furnishings further minimizes environmental impact over time.

Energy management plays an equally crucial role in household sustainability as urban areas continue expanding. Switching to energy-efficient LED lighting and unplugging idle electronic devices prevents unnecessary power consumption during peak hours. Furthermore, establishing a __**comprehensive__** indoor sorting system for organic waste and recyclables encourages mindful consumption habits among all household members, fostering a cleaner community.

Ultimately, building an eco-friendly home is a gradual journey of awareness rather than an overnight transformation. Residents should focus on progressive improvements that align with their personal routines and household budgets. These thoughtful adjustments ultimately foster a healthier living space for both current occupants and future generations, ensuring a __**flourishing__** ecosystem at the residential level.

view_a.title: Composting Benefits the Environment
view_a.text: Composting organic kitchen waste significantly reduces the volume of garbage sent to municipal landfills. While managing food scraps indoors requires some initial effort, the positive impact on local soil health and waste reduction is undeniable for modern cities.

view_b.title: Practical Challenges Limit Adoption
view_b.text: Indoor composting can attract unwanted pests and create unpleasant odours in compact apartments. Although the environmental intentions are good, practical limitations make strict composting systems unsuitable for many busy city residents who lack outdoor space.

trap.title: Using 'Garbage' or 'Waste' as a Countable Noun
trap.wrong: Please throw away these garbages before leaving the office.
trap.right: Please throw away this garbage before leaving the office.
trap.explanation: In English, words like 'garbage', 'waste', and 'equipment' are uncountable nouns. They do not take an 's' at the end and require singular verbs. Thai speakers often translate '__khaya__', which can feel collective, into a plural form, but you must use uninflected forms like 'some garbage' or 'this waste'.
